title: Accountability Lane: Evidence Ownership Calendar & Cutover Playbook
creator: Riley Carter
description: Objective: Define a single, authoritative "Accountability Lane" that maps every SOC2/ISO evidence artifact to a rotating owner, a scheduled collection window, and an automated ingestion/validation job. The playbook covers pre-cutover readiness, the cutover weekend runbook, rollback conditions, and post-cutover evidence reconciliation. This reduces manual evidence collection, shortens audit prep time, and ensures SSO/audit-log controls have explicit owners and SLAs.
milestones: Milestone 1 — Owner Roster & Calendar (2026-03-15): finalize a monthly rota for evidence owners across Platform, Security, and SRE.
Milestone 2 — Evidence Contract & TTL (2026-03-22): publish canonical list of evidence artifacts, retention TTLs, and validation schema in Confluence.
Milestone 3 — Automation: Ingestion & Validation (2026-03-29): deploy evidence-sync lambda and validation pipeline (staging).
Milestone 4 — Dry Runs & Cutover Rehearsals (2026-04-05): run two end-to-end rehearsals with owners, capture runbook gaps.
Milestone 5 — Production Cutover & Validation (2026-04-12): execute cutover, monitor, and reconcile within 24 hours.
Milestone 6 — Post-Cutover Audit Report (2026-04-15): publish reconciliation report and corrective actions.
Milestone 7 — Handoff to Operations (2026-04-20): transfer calendar and playbook to runbook-ops and schedule quarterly reviews.
acceptance_criteria: Every evidence artifact listed in the contract has a named owner and a calendar slot assigned.
Automation pipeline ingests >95% of scheduled artifacts to the evidence bucket in staging with validation results.
Cutover rehearsal completes with no more than 2 high-priority runbook gaps; gaps have owners and closure dates.
Post-cutover reconciliation shows <=1% missing critical artifacts; any missing items have remediation tasks assigned.
Runbook includes explicit rollback gates (service impact, ingestion failure rate, permission drift) and an SLA to escalate to oncall within 30 minutes.
risks: Owner bandwidth: owners are overloaded during the cutover week — mitigations: temporary deputization and paired owners.
Automation false negatives: validation rules incorrectly reject valid artifacts — mitigation: shadow-mode validation for first 48 hours.
Permission scoping: evidence ingestion agent lacks read access in certain regions — mitigation: access matrix audit and pre-cutover permission checks.
Customer panic: scheduled audit window overlaps with a customer-facing incident — mitigation: define safe windows and communicate to GTM.
